general.description: Client capabilities that do not belong to a broader feature group.

batching.description: Full support executes atomic and non-atomic batches through the native GLIDE Batch API and exposes public batch controls such as cluster routing, timeout, and retry behavior.

cluster_scan.description: Topology aware cluster scan through GLIDE's API.

topology_awareness.description: Discovers and maintains node roles, cluster slot ownership, and topology changes.

custom_address_resolution.description: Maps addresses announced by the cluster to addresses reachable by the client.

data_compression.description: Compresses supported values in the client before sending them to the server.

custom_commands.description: Executes commands that do not have a dedicated client method.

multi_slot_command_handling.description: Splits supported multi-key commands by hash slot and routes them to the appropriate shards.

pubsub.description: Publishes messages and manages channel or pattern subscriptions.

lua_scripting_api.description: Provide a Script object for executing and managing Lua scripts. Exposing ordinary scripting commands does not count.

client_side_caching.description: Capabilities for caching read responses, invalidating stale entries, and observing cache performance.
Caches eligible read responses in client memory.

server_assisted_cache_invalidation.description: Invalidates cached entries from server tracking notifications when data changes outside the client.

client_cache_metrics.description: Reports cache hits, misses, entries, evictions, expirations, and lookups.

command_routing.description: Capabilities that determine which cluster node receives a command.

request_routing.description: Routes requests to a specified node or set of nodes.

read_strategies.description: Controls whether reads target primary nodes, replicas, or affinity-based replicas.

az_affinity.description: Read strategies targeting the client's availability zone.

standalone_read_only_mode.description: Restricts standalone clients to read-only commands and supports replica-only deployments.

high_availability.description: Capabilities that protect and recover requests during failures or topology changes.

automatic_reconnection.description: Reconnects dropped connections without requiring the application to recreate the client.

timeout_and_reconnect_configuration.description: Configures request and connection timeouts and exponential reconnection backoff.

circuit_breaker.description: Rejects requests quickly when sustained failures indicate that the client is unhealthy.

in_flight_request_limits.description: Limits the number of concurrent requests awaiting completion.

lazy_connections.description: Defers physical connections until the first command is executed.

aws_iam_authentication.description: Authenticates to supported AWS services using IAM credentials.

dynamic_credential_rotation.description: Updates authentication credentials without recreating the client.

custom_tls_trust_roots.description: Trusts caller-provided CA certificates when validating TLS servers.

mutual_tls.description: Authenticates both the client and server with TLS certificates.

observability.description: Logging, command monitoring, metrics, and tracing capabilities.

client_statistics.description: Reports client and connection resource counts from the GLIDE core.

glide_logging.description: Emits GLIDE client logs with configurable levels and destinations.

monitor_streaming.description: Streams commands observed through the Valkey MONITOR command.

opentelemetry.description: Exports client metrics and distributed traces through OpenTelemetry.

modules_api.description: Dedicated client interfaces for supported Valkey modules.

json.description: Provides typed methods for the Valkey JSON module.

bloom.description: Provides typed methods for Bloom filter operations.

search.description: Provides typed methods for Valkey Search operations.
